# Key manager

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P2 · Proven identity](../README.md#phase-2--proven-identity) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:key-management` · **Epic:** [#75](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/75) · **Tickets:** 5 (2S 3M)

Adds a signing-key subsystem to the control plane that owns every key the CP signs with (Warden tokens, policy bundles). Keys carry a kid, rotate on a schedule with an overlap window, and are published as a JWKS so workers and harnesses can verify without a shared secret.

## How we build it

- New package internal/keys with `type Signer interface { KID() string; Alg() string; Public() crypto.PublicKey; Sign(ctx, payload []byte) ([]byte, error) }` and a `KeySet` that holds one active key plus retired-but-published keys; the Phase 5 KMS signers implement the same interface.
- Supported algs: EdDSA (Ed25519, default) and ES256; kid = base64url(SHA-256(JWK thumbprint, RFC 7638)).
- Private keys stored through the existing secrets.SecretStore (Put/Get) under `warden/cp/keys/<purpose>/<kid>`; CP SQLite stores only metadata (kid, alg, purpose, state active|next|retired, created_at, activates_at, retires_at).
- Rotation: config `keys.rotationInterval` (default 30d) and `keys.overlap` (default 48h, must exceed max token TTL + bundle poll interval); a next key is published in JWKS `overlap` before it becomes active, the old key stays published `overlap` after retirement.
- `GET /.well-known/jwks.json` (unauthenticated, Cache-Control max-age=300) on the CP mux in internal/controlplane Handler; also exposed as `KeySet.JWKS()` for embedding in signed bundles.
- Fail closed: if the active key cannot be loaded from the secret backend at startup the CP refuses to mint tokens or bundles and /healthz reports degraded.

## Done when

The CP signs with a kid-tagged key loaded from the secret backend, publishes it at /.well-known/jwks.json, and a forced rotation drill completes with no verification failures for in-flight tokens.

## Needs first

Nothing. This feature can start now.

### 1/5 · W-P2-KEYS-01

**Add internal/keys Signer interface and local Ed25519/ES256 signers**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#76](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/76)

Create new package internal/keys with the Signer interface, Ed25519 and ES256 (P-256, crypto/ecdsa) implementations, RFC 7638 thumbprint kid derivation, and JWK marshal/unmarshal for public keys (OKP and EC). Add `Verify(jwk, alg, payload, sig)` helper used later by the worker. Reuse nothing from internal/audit's receipt Signer beyond the Ed25519 approach; the audit signer stays as-is.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Sign/verify round-trip passes for EdDSA and ES256
- [ ] kid is stable for the same public key and matches RFC 7638 test vectors
- [ ] JWK JSON of an Ed25519 key has kty=OKP, crv=Ed25519, and no private member

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-TOKX-01`](token-exchange.md#15--w-p2-tokx-01) Add private_key_jwt client assertion verification; [`W-P2-KEYS-02`](key-management.md#25--w-p2-keys-02) Persist signing keys in secret backend with metadata in CP SQLite; [`W-P2-SBND-01`](signed-bundles.md#15--w-p2-sbnd-01) Add internal/bundle canonical format, sign and verify

### 2/5 · W-P2-KEYS-02

**Persist signing keys in secret backend with metadata in CP SQLite**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#77](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/77)

Add a KeyStore in internal/keys that writes the PKCS#8 private key via secrets.SecretStore.Put under `warden/cp/keys/<purpose>/<kid>` and stores metadata rows (kid, alg, purpose, state, timestamps) in a `signing_keys` table in the CP state DB (migration added alongside the P1 policy-history schema). On startup `LoadKeySet(purpose)` loads active+published keys; when none exist it generates the first key. Startup with an unreachable backend returns an error and the CP does not mint.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Restart of the CP reuses the same active kid
- [ ] No private key bytes appear in the SQLite file (grep test)
- [ ] Backend Get failure at startup makes token/bundle signing return ErrNoActiveKey

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-KEYS-01`](key-management.md#15--w-p2-keys-01) Add internal/keys Signer interface and local Ed25519/ES256 signers

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-TOKX-02`](token-exchange.md#25--w-p2-tokx-02) Implement token exchange policy checks and JWT minting; [`W-P2-KEYS-03`](key-management.md#35--w-p2-keys-03) Implement rotation schedule with overlap window; [`W-P2-WCA-01`](worker-mtls.md#16--w-p2-wca-01) Add internal/workerca intermediate CA and cert issuance

### 3/5 · W-P2-KEYS-03

**Implement rotation schedule with overlap window**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#78](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/78)

Add `KeySet.Rotate(now)` and a ticker goroutine in the controlplane Server (started next to the retention pruner) driven by config keys `keys.rotationInterval` and `keys.overlap` parsed in internal/config. State machine next -> active -> retired -> deleted; JWKS includes next, active and retired-within-overlap keys. Validate at config load that overlap > token TTL (15m) + long-poll wait. Each transition writes an admin audit entry via the P1 admin audit log.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Fake clock test: next key appears in JWKS overlap before activation
- [ ] Retired key leaves JWKS only after overlap
- [ ] Config with overlap < 20m is rejected at load

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-KEYS-02`](key-management.md#25--w-p2-keys-02) Persist signing keys in secret backend with metadata in CP SQLite

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-KEYS-04`](key-management.md#45--w-p2-keys-04) Serve /.well-known/jwks.json from the control plane; [`W-P2-SBND-02`](signed-bundles.md#25--w-p2-sbnd-02) Serve signed bundle envelope on GET /policy

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] ETag changes on rotation and 304 is returned for a matching If-None-Match
